meta.principle: Every strategy must pass validation gates before being ranked on the leaderboard. Luck is removed by: (1) unit-normalised scoring on settled picks only, (2) minimum-sample gates, (3) Wilson-interval skill tests vs break-even, (4) correlation caps on parlays/props, (5) selective release — strategies only bet when edge >= threshold. No strategy earns rewards until gate suite passes; unvalidated strategies are labelled PAPER.
meta.correlation_policy: Correlation values are computed from official NBA last-5 game logs and official league tables (see data/correlations.json). Parlays/props that exceed correlation caps are rejected at generation time.

strategies.name: Edge Single (moneyline/spread)
strategies.description: Originate a fair line for every slate game from official team strength (net rating proxy = PTS - OPPG), rest days, and injury production-at-risk. Bet only when our line diverges from a neutral baseline by >= edge_threshold and model confidence passes gates. One unit flat stake.
strategies.model: fair_margin = 0.5*(net_rating_home - net_rating_away) + homecourt_assumption + rest_adjustment + injury_impact_home - injury_impact_away; fair_total = (pts_home + oppg_away + pts_away + oppg_home)/2 adjusted for injury production out
strategies.parameters_note: homecourt 2.5 pts, b2b penalty and injury weights/cap/gate are MODEL ASSUMPTIONS, not official NBA facts - flagged hca-01/w-01 in flagged.json pending calibration
strategies.parameter_revision: rev-A: injury_ppg_weight 0.6->0.35, cap 10.0 added (implausible margins). rev-B: rotation gate - only OUT players with GP>=60% of team GP count (prevents double-counting absences already priced into season stats). Both pre-settlement, 0 settled picks. Recorded 2026-11-13.

validation_gates.rule: >= 30 settled picks before any skill claim
Wilson 90% CI of ROI must exclude 0 (or ATS win rate CI excludes 52.4% break-even at -110)
mean |our_line - baseline| must stay >= 2.0 pts across 30 picks (model not collapsing to baseline)
injury report used must be < 6h old at pick time for game day
validation_gates.state: FAIL for 11/15-16 games (reports not published) -> picks gated to provisional

validation_gates.rule: every pick row must carry source_url to schedule + stats + injury report

luck_controls: no cherry-picking: every eligible game gets a released-or-pass record

strategies.name: Correlated Double
strategies.description: Two S1 legs from the SAME game (e.g., favourite cover + over). Uses joint probability with computed correlation instead of naive independence. Only released when joint edge >= parlay_edge_threshold and leg correlation is measured, not assumed.

validation_gates.rule: rho between legs must come from data/correlations.json with n>=5; if unavailable -> REJECT parlay
joint p computed as p(A)+p(B)-p(A)*p(B) - rho*min(pA,pB)*(1-max(pA,pB)) bounded [max(0,pA+pB-1), min(pA,pB)]; naive independence prohibited

luck_controls: pass record kept for rejected combos

strategies.name: Prop Stack (player points combo)
strategies.description: Two same-team player points props combined (e.g., Brunson 25+ & Towns 20+). Requires teammate PTS correlation from official last-5 logs; rejects stacks when either player is Out/Doubtful per official injury report.

validation_gates.rule: both players status in {not listed, Probable, Available} per latest official report; Questionable -> flagged review; Out/Doubtful -> auto-reject
teammate rho must be computed from official Last-5 tables (n>=5); else stack released only as singles with flag

strategies.name: Rest/Fatigue Favourite
strategies.description: Subset of S1: only games where rest differential >= 2 days (opponent on back-to-back or 0-1 rest vs our side >= 2). Hypothesis: rest edges persist in the first month of the season. Uses only official schedule-derived rest values.

validation_gates.rule: >= 25 settled picks (subset strategy needs larger N)
must beat S1's settled ROI before promotion to leaderboard rank 1
rest values must be computed from official schedule PDF only

rules: Ranking metric: settled-pick ROI with Wilson 90% CI reported alongside; strategies with CI containing break-even are shown as 'not yet distinguished from luck'.
Minimum games before a strategy may be called 'skill-positive': strategy-specific gate N (30/20/15/25) AND CI excludes break-even.

Rewards: (1) weekly crown = highest settled ROI among gate-passing strategies; (2) 'Gate Champion' badge = first strategy to pass all gates; (3) unit allocation: top-ranked strategy receives 2x unit sizing in the following week's paper book, capped at 2%; others 1x.
Paper book starts at 100 units; bankruptcy rule: strategy dropped from live board below 50 units (historical record retained).
Every week the board freezes; no retroactive edits to settled picks.
